How to read: Gap = mismatch OR hard-coded value where token should be used, Match = correct value AND uses token-backed class, Verify = needs code inspection to confirm token usage (not just value match).

10. Rich content rendering

Dev
Dev
PropertyDesign tokenDev implementationRequired changeStatus
Card grid layout on mobile On mobile (390px), multi-column comparison grids should stack into a single column with each state as its own card 4-5 columns shown side-by-side overflow the panel — "New Hampshire" text hard-cut, content inaccessible Switch to single-column stacked layout on mobile. Each comparison item (Florida, Georgia, etc.) gets its own full-width card stacked vertically. Gap
No horizontal scroll indicator on card grids Design does not address wide content overflow explicitly Data table (State/Structure) has a ">" chevron indicating horizontal scroll, but card grid above has NO affordance Apply same scroll affordance pattern (chevron or fade) to ALL horizontally-overflowing containers Gap
Inconsistent overflow handling All content should handle overflow consistently openui-table uses scroll indicator (">"); comparison cards just clip Unify overflow behavior — all wide content should use the same scroll pattern with visible indicator Gap
Text truncation without ellipsis Text should never hard-clip on mobile (per chat design principles) "New Hampshir" is hard-clipped at container edge — no ellipsis, no fade, no indication content continues Prevent hard-clip: either wrap text, show ellipsis, or add scroll container Gap
AI heading typography Headings should fit within 320px content width without issues "State Tax Code Comparison — 2026" heading fits but uses large bold text — acceptable — Match
AI paragraph text wrapping Text wraps naturally within message width Body text wraps correctly within container — Match
Data table (State/Structure) scroll Table should be scrollable when wider than panel Has ">" chevron affordance indicating horizontal scroll works — Match
Visible horizontal scrollbar on tables Scrollbars should be hidden (use overflow-x: auto with scrollbar-width: none or ::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none }) Visible orange/tan scrollbar appears at bottom of table sections — looks out of place on mobile Hide native scrollbar. Use CSS scrollbar-width: none and ::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none } while keeping overflow-x: auto for swipe gesture support Gap

11. Navigation sidebar

Design
Dev
PropertyDesign tokenDev implementationRequired changeStatus
Nav sections default state Nav / Section Header (expanded ∨) is default component. Nav / Panel shows all sections expanded with child items visible. Sections default to COLLAPSED on both mobile and desktop — user must manually expand each section to see nav items Set defaultOpen={true} or equivalent on all nav section accordions. The collapsed state (Nav / Section Header Collapsed) should only appear after user explicitly collapses. Gap
Nav section header component Nav / Section Header (waW4Z) — expanded with ∨ chevron Uses > chevron (collapsed variant) as initial render Render Nav / Section Header component (expanded) by default, not Nav / Section Header Collapsed Gap

Dev
PropertyDesign tokenDev implementationRequired changeStatus
Continue button background component/Button → $colors-btnPrimaryBg = #0E0E0E rgb(14,14,14) = #0E0E0E — exact match — Match
Continue button text color component/Button → $colors-btnPrimaryText = #EEEDEB rgb(238,237,235) = #EEEDEB — exact match — Match
Continue button corner radius component/Button → $radius-full = 9999px (pill) border-radius: 9999px — matches — Match
Continue button font family component/Button → Heebo "Heebo Variable", sans-serif — correct — Match
Continue button font size component/Button → 16px 16px — correct — Match
Continue button text alignment component/Button → text centered (justify-content: center, align-items: center) display: flex — text appears left-aligned, not centered Add justify-content: center and align-items: center to button or use text-align: center Gap
Continue button height component/Button → 48px min-height ($spacing-2xl) height: 32px — 16px too short, fails WCAG touch target (44px min) Set min-height: 48px. Current 32px fails accessibility touch target guidelines. Gap
Continue button font weight component/Button → font-weight: 600 (semibold) font-weight: 400 (regular) — text too thin Change to font-weight: 600 per component/Button spec Gap
Continue button padding component/Button → padding: 12px 24px ($spacing-xs / $spacing-md) padding: 5px 16px — undersized, causes 32px height Change to padding: 12px 24px per component/Button Gap
Page scroll behavior Page must be scrollable — all content including legal disclaimers must be accessible overflow: hidden on html, body, AND container div. Content 1096px in 907px viewport — 189px inaccessible Remove overflow: hidden. Allow natural page scrolling. Gap
Continue button position (fixed) Button in content flow or sticky with scrollable content behind position: fixed; bottom: 0 (class "fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0"). Content cannot scroll. Make content area scrollable with padding-bottom, or use sticky/relative positioning Gap
Legal disclaimer accessibility All legal/compliance text must be fully readable Disclaimer clipped by overflow:hidden — user cannot scroll to read full legal text Critical compliance issue — legal disclaimers must be fully accessible before Continue Gap

Error state: error bubble Blue-tinted bubble with error message Verify — requires triggering error state. Check token usage when visible. — Verify
Thinking state: single indicator only Chat / Message / AI Thinking (p6LC4S): ONE thinking indicator shown at a time — three dots + one status message MULTIPLE thinking indicators stacked/duplicated. "Formulating response..." appears 2× in sequence. "Checking current market price..." and "Fetching Apple's price history..." shown simultaneously. Only render ONE thinking indicator at a time. When a new status message arrives, REPLACE the previous one — do not stack multiple thinking messages. Gap
Thinking dots styling Three dots in gray/taupe gradient (animated pulsing) — uses $chat.text.secondary tones Dots appear in correct gray/taupe tones — matches design — Match
Thinking status text color Status text in $chat.text.placeholder (→ #A8A49E) — light, secondary appearance Status text in lighter color — appears correct — Match
Thinking status text: single line One status message below the dots (e.g., "Generating your retirement projection...") Multiple status lines stacked vertically — "Checking current market price..." then "Fetching Apple's price history..." as separate lines Show only the LATEST status message. Replace previous status text when a new one arrives. Gap
